name: Oskarn Post 114 EGEO
description: Key Features High Throughput Capacity: Processes up to 729 litres per hour, making it ideal for large-scale water treatment, desalination, or industrial fluid management applications. Optimized Operating Temperature: Functions efficiently at 65°C, supporting consistent evaporation performance and energy efficiency. Salinity Handling: Designed for feed water with salinity levels up to 21 parts per thousand, suitable for brackish water or moderate saline environments. Extended Media Service Life: Offers a media service duration of 1,424 hours, reducing the frequency of maintenance and downtime. Gravity-Fed Energy Source: Utilizes gravity as the primary energy input, minimizing operational costs and supporting sustainable, low-energy operations. Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific project requirements. Main Benefits Efficient Desalination and Water Purification: Meets the needs of users seeking reliable removal of salts and impurities from water, improving water quality for industrial, agricultural, or municipal use. Cost-Effective Operation: Gravity-fed design reduces energy consumption compared to pump-driven systems, appealing to users prioritizing operational savings and sustainability. Low Maintenance Requirements: Extended media service life means fewer interruptions, less labor, and lower replacement costs for operators. Adaptable to Various Salinity Levels: Effectively processes moderately saline feed water, addressing common challenges in regions with brackish water supplies. Typical Use Cases or Outcomes Industrial Water Treatment: Suitable for factories and processing plants requiring high-volume water purification or process water recovery. Desalination Facilities: Ideal for small- to mid-scale desalination operations in coastal or inland areas with brackish water sources. Agricultural Irrigation: Enables farmers to utilize non-potable water sources for irrigation by reducing salt content, supporting crop health and yield. Remote or Off-Grid Locations: Gravity-fed operation makes this evaporator a practical solution where electrical infrastructure is limited or unavailable. Frequently Asked Questions Is the unit easy to operate and maintain? Yes, the gravity-fed design and long media service interval simplify operation and lower maintenance needs. What types of water sources can it handle? The evaporator is suitable for feed water up to 21 ppt salinity, including brackish or lightly saline sources. What is the expected lifespan of the media? The media is rated for 1,424 hours of service, supporting extended operational periods before replacement is necessary. How is pricing determined? Pricing is customized based on project scope and requirements, ensuring a solution tailored to your needs.
description_html:
Key Features

  • High Throughput Capacity: Processes up to 729 litres per hour, making it ideal for large-scale water treatment, desalination, or industrial fluid management applications.
  • Optimized Operating Temperature: Functions efficiently at 65°C, supporting consistent evaporation performance and energy efficiency.
  • Salinity Handling: Designed for feed water with salinity levels up to 21 parts per thousand, suitable for brackish water or moderate saline environments.
  • Extended Media Service Life: Offers a media service duration of 1,424 hours, reducing the frequency of maintenance and downtime.
  • Gravity-Fed Energy Source: Utilizes gravity as the primary energy input, minimizing operational costs and supporting sustainable, low-energy operations.
  • Flexible Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Efficient Desalination and Water Purification: Meets the needs of users seeking reliable removal of salts and impurities from water, improving water quality for industrial, agricultural, or municipal use.
  • Cost-Effective Operation: Gravity-fed design reduces energy consumption compared to pump-driven systems, appealing to users prioritizing operational savings and sustainability.
  • Low Maintenance Requirements: Extended media service life means fewer interruptions, less labor, and lower replacement costs for operators.
  • Adaptable to Various Salinity Levels: Effectively processes moderately saline feed water, addressing common challenges in regions with brackish water supplies.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Industrial Water Treatment: Suitable for factories and processing plants requiring high-volume water purification or process water recovery.
  • Desalination Facilities: Ideal for small- to mid-scale desalination operations in coastal or inland areas with brackish water sources.
  • Agricultural Irrigation: Enables farmers to utilize non-potable water sources for irrigation by reducing salt content, supporting crop health and yield.
  • Remote or Off-Grid Locations: Gravity-fed operation makes this evaporator a practical solution where electrical infrastructure is limited or unavailable.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the unit easy to operate and maintain? Yes, the gravity-fed design and long media service interval simplify operation and lower maintenance needs.
  • What types of water sources can it handle? The evaporator is suitable for feed water up to 21 ppt salinity, including brackish or lightly saline sources.
  • What is the expected lifespan of the media? The media is rated for 1,424 hours of service, supporting extended operational periods before replacement is necessary.
  • How is pricing determined? Pricing is customized based on project scope and requirements, ensuring a solution tailored to your needs.
